mentions.name: Athanor Tools
mentions.description: A web-based platform for running common biological synthesis and protein-modification software from a web UI, with published Rust and Python libraries and a CLI application; the tooling is also integrated into the Molchanica molecule viewer/editor.
mentions.problem: Common software in the biological synthesis area varies in ease of install, making it hard to run.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've launched this site to help run them from a web UI: https://athanortools.com/, published Rust and Python libs and a CLI application, and integrated them into my mol viewing/editing software Molchanica.

evidence.value: I've launched this site to help run them from a web UI: https://athanortools.com/, published Rust and Python libs and a CLI application, and integrated them into my mol viewing/editing software Molchanica.
